title: print page: the record approval strip ("Recall approval", the approval status badge, "Approvals — 0 of 1") prints on paper — DetailView does not read the print context
body:
Filing gate ①: a class-a finding from the live printed reading on objectui#12732 (the os-dev delta posted on that card; PR #12747). Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

reach: the live printed PDF, both placements (the record route and the named page route), before and after objectui#12732's fix. Measured on a published `@objectstack/*@18.0.0-next.2` showcase backend, on a throwaway A4 `print` page added to `showcase_invoice` in the throwaway copy only, because the showcase declares no print page. The print chain is under the maintainer's rule 「PDF 要赶 18.0 正式版」, as triage quoted it on objectui#12717.

## Measured

- On paper, the record page's approval strip prints:
  - the "Recall approval" button;
  - the "In approval · editable" status badge;
  - the "Approvals — 0 of 1" progress line.
- The PNGs are on branch `claude/issue-12732-evidence`, commit `8c201ec`, under `evidence/12732/live/`.

## Static read (objectui `main` `c9e6742`)

- The strip is drawn by `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx`: the status badge (`detail.approvalPendingEditable` / `detail.lockedByApproval`, around `:1680`–`:1700`), the recall button (`detail.cancelApproval`, around `:1741`–`:1748`) and the progress line (`detail.approvalProgress`, around `:1761`–`:1767`).
- `DetailView.tsx` never reads `usePrintPage()`. The readers of the print context today are `DetailSection.tsx` (objectui#11958, #12717 and #12732), `page.tsx` and `LineItemsPanel.tsx`.
- This is the same defect class as objectui#12717 and objectui#12732: a screen-only control on paper.

## For triage to scope

- The recall button is a control and plainly has no place on paper.
- Whether the status badge and the progress line are document content (a printed record that says it is awaiting approval) or screen chrome is a design call, and it decides whether they hide or print as plain text.

Dedupe: `search_issues` in objectui with "print page approval recall button badge progress on paper" returned 4 results: #12491 (open, the approval request page's progress line, not print), #12732 (the collapsible header), and #12482 and #12072 (closed, approval faces). None covers the approval strip on paper.
